items.content:
She led with "don't be weird about it." Which tells you she already knew.
He's coming. Mom's fine with it — Mom is *delighted* with it, because Gary
will be there and she gets to be the one who landed on her feet. It's a
performance and Dad is the prop. I'm not a prop. I just haven't figured
out how to say that in a way that doesn't make me the problem.

summary: The estranged father's Thanksgiving attendance, relayed by a sister's call
title: Mara called about Thanksgiving
